LDA sky_rh,X
    STA s_ptr + 1
    LDA sky_rn,X
    STA sky_n
    EOR #&FF
    SEC
    ADC #8
    STA sky_skip
    LDA sky_rt,X
    ORA sky_ry,X
    TAY

\ sky_draw: helicopter sky_s's image over the rectangle's columns drawn: a whole character row four
\ bytes a loop, a part row's cells from an entry into eight lines unrolled
.sky_draw
{
    LDA sky_d1
    ASL A
    ASL A
    ASL A
    STA sky_j8
    LDX #0
.row
    STX sky_q
    LDA sky_rb,X                    \ the image: its block, + 8 * the first column drawn
    LDY sky_s
    BEQ h0
    ORA #4
.h0
    TAY
    LDA sky_blk_lo,Y
    CLC
candidates.new:
LDA sky_rh,X
    STA s_ptr + 1
    LDA sky_rt,X
    ORA sky_ry,X
    TAY
    LDA sky_rn,X
    STA sky_n
    DEC A                           \ 65C02 opcode: n is 1 to 8, so 8 - n = (n - 1) EOR 7
    EOR #7
    STA sky_skip                    \ (A = 8 - n and Z for the caller: no reload)
    RTS
    SKIP 1                          \ (so the code after stays at its addresses)

\ sky_draw: helicopter sky_s's image over the rectangle's columns drawn: a whole character row four
\ bytes a loop, a part row's cells from an entry into eight lines unrolled
.sky_draw
{
    LDA sky_s                       \ the OR below: 4 for helicopter 1 (sky_s is 0 or 1), 0 for helicopter 0
    ASL A
    ASL A
    STA g93_or + 1                  \ self-modified
    LDA sky_d1
    ASL A
    ASL A
    ASL A
    STA sky_j8
    LDX #0
    CLC                             \ (clear to the add below: next_row's CPX leaves it so, X below sky_nq)
.row
    STX sky_q
    LDA sky_rb,X                    \ the image: its block, + 8 * the first column drawn
.g93_or
    ORA #0                          \ self-modified: sky_s * 4
    TAY
    LDA sky_blk_lo,Y
candidates.summary: ALL of the window: A + B + the s-dependent OR made a self-modified immediate. (1) sky_row as candidate A (DEC A/EOR #7, no reload of sky_skip) with 1 byte of padding; (2) the CLC moved out of the row loop to once in the prologue (candidate B); (3) the per-row LDY sky_s/BEQ h0/ORA #4 (6 bytes, 5-8 cycles a row) becomes ORA #imm (2 bytes, 2 cycles) whose operand sky_draw sets at entry to 4 * sky_s (LDA sky_s/ASL/ASL/STA, 7 bytes, 11 cycles once a call). Net bytes 0 with the SKIP, so the code after line 141 keeps every address (checked in the assembled listing: next_row, done, sky_zero, sky_img0 identical). Alternative to E, A and B (overlaps them all). Measured (pcprof seed 1, 1500 passes from 500, unshifted DEBUG_LIVES build, 2026-10-22): cycles in &3080-&313F 2178.2 -> 2158.0 a pass, work excluding the wait 35621.2 -> 35601.1.
candidates.equivalence: sky_row: entries are JSRs from sky_draw, sky_zero and sky_check only (grep: no sky_row + N); X = a row entry, untouched. sky_rn is 1 to 8 on every entry (sky_geom: the bottom row is sky_L + 1 with sky_L 0-7; the others 8, or what is left, 1-8, since sky_H is a helicopter's height of 23+ lines, > 8), so 8 - n = 7 - (n - 1) = (n - 1) EOR 7 (n = 8 gives 0 as before). Writes: s_ptr+1 (same value), sky_n (same), sky_skip (same value), Y = sky_rt,X OR sky_ry,X (same, only computed earlier; A and the flags are dead across it). Exit: A = sky_skip with Z/N from that value (the old LDA sky_skip set the same Z/N; the new EOR sets them from the same byte, the STA between changes nothing), Y and X as before. C and V differ at exit (old: C=1, V from the ADC; new: both unchanged from entry); no caller reads either: sky_draw's BNE part goes to ASL A/ASL A (which set C) and its whole-row path goes to next_row whose CPX sets C; sky_zero and sky_check do BNE cell then LDX sky_n / SEC; no branch on C or V follows a JSR sky_row anywhere in src/. CLC: the carry is clear at every entry to .row: the first from the new CLC after LDX #0, later ones from JMP row after next_row's CPX sky_nq with BEQ done not taken, so X = sky_q + 1 < sky_nq (sky_q < sky_nq; sky_nq >= 2 after sky_geom succeeds, and sky_draw is only called at sky.6502:248 after geom/sky_check); STX, LDA abs,X, LDY, BEQ, ORA, TAY, LDA abs,Y leave C alone, so ADC sky_j8 sees C = 0 as after the old CLC. The OR: sky_s is 0 or 1 (sky.6502: 'the helicopter: 0, 1'; sky_image indexes sky_k with ORA #2 * 4 on it), so the old 'ORA #4 iff sky_s <> 0' equals ORA #(4 * sky_s); A = rb OR 4s goes to TAY as before; the old LDY sky_s only set Y (overwritten by TAY) and nothing read N/Z/Y between. g93_or + 1 is written at sky_draw's entry and nothing else touches that byte; the ORA is reached only after the write, in the same call, in the same ACCCON state (sky_row does not change it): exactly the situation of the existing STA cell + 1 in the same routine. The SKIP 1 is after the RTS, never executed. Label h0 is removed (scoped inside sky_draw; only the BEQ referred to it).
candidates.relies_on: Self-modifying code like the existing cell + 1: main RAM &30xx is per screen (render_reset copies the code to shadow) and the store is in the same ACCCON state as the ORA. Page crossings: none moved after line 141 (padded: .cell &3101, .next_row &3133, .done &313D, .sky_zero &313E, .sky_img0 &317F, all identical to the control in the assembled listing); inside the window the BEQ h0 is gone and no other branch crosses a page (all in &30xx). Checked: assembled as the bench build; passlock 3000 passes seed 1 --screen identical (state and shown screen); helilock flight identical (framesDiffering 0).
